EmailTemplate.description: Financial Aid General Case Management Template
EmailTemplate.name: Case Management Financial Aid General
EmailTemplate.subject: RE: {!Case.Subject}
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Contact.FirstName},
If you have any questions you may respond to this email within 14 days and your case will be reopened and evaluated by Financial Aid and Scholarship Services.
Please add permissions using My ASU Parent Guest Access if you would like to authorize designated persons to discuss your financial aid.
Sincerely, {!User.FirstName} {!User.LastName}
Financial Aid and Scholarship Services Arizona State University PO Box 870412 Tempe, AZ 85287-0412 Phone: 855-278-5080
If you have any additional information or questions related to this, please reply to this email.
